basic_info.description:
Discover quintessential Noe Valley living and panoramic views in this top-floor condo within a classic Edwardian building, a rare opportunity to experience authentic San Francisco style. Refinished original hardwood floors extend throughout, and a beautifully restored brick and stone fireplace anchors the living space. The bay window alcove offers a scenic view of Noe Valley and the rolling hills that define the city's iconic skyline.
The renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, white shaker cabinetry, marble countertops, a modern vent hood, and open shelving for a contemporary touch. Two bright bedrooms offer flexibility and comfort, while a full hallway bathroom completes the layout.
Just a short flight up is a shared rooftop deck with sweeping city views. Additional highlights include deeded parking (one of only two units with this amenity), dedicated storage, and on-site laundry.
Outside, Noe Valley's vibrant community awaits, with locally-owned restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and more all just a block away. Enjoy convenient access to the MUNI J-Church line, connecting you seamlessly to San Francisco's diverse neighborhoods and cultural attractions.
